units.notes: The permit confirms 36 Cummins DQLF engines. The 99 MW total uses 2.75 MW electrical per engine from the Cummins DQLF product page https://www.cummins.com/en-na/generators/products/dqlf. The permit gives 3,997 horsepower, which is mechanical output and not the electrical rating. No start year is given in the permit. Latest Activity is left alone because the permit is under a year old.

qa.question: Which point is the Citadel data center site, GEM's or the permit's?
qa.finding: The Oklahoma Department of Environmental Quality permit memo at https://oklahoma.gov/content/dam/ok/en/deq/documents/air-quality/Citadel%20Facility-2026-0286-C.pdf gives latitude 36.27133 and longitude -95.90837. The same memo says the site is at North Yale Avenue and East 86th Street North in Sperry, which geocodes to 36.27857, -95.91994, about 100 meters from GEM's point of 36.27924, -95.91897. The permit point is about 1.3 kilometers from GEM's point.
qa.recommendation: Leave the point and the approximate accuracy as they are. Ask the permit engineer or check a county parcel map for the Yale and 86th Street site before making it exact.
qa.note: Satellite images show ground with no data center built at either place, and the imagery date is unknown. The permit directions start from Owasso and fit the permit point better than the street address. Pin links: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=36.27133,-95.90837 and https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=36.27924,-95.91897

qa.question: Should the 10 smaller backup engines at Citadel be added as a unit?
qa.finding: The permit at https://oklahoma.gov/content/dam/ok/en/deq/documents/air-quality/Citadel%20Facility-2026-0286-C.pdf lists 6 engines of 2,584 horsepower and 4 engines of 1,340 horsepower besides the 108 engines in the two units, plus one fire pump. At about 1.75 MW for the first six, the groups sum to about 10.5 MW and about 5 MW.
qa.recommendation: Leave them out. They sum well under the 50 MW bar.
qa.note: This matches the existing database note from November 4, 2026.

source_log.note: Read the full memo and permit with fetch.py.
The brief's queue row GEN-2005-024 is a 181 MW gas plant in service since 2007. It does not describe a diesel data center fleet and was not used.

location.location_route: The permit memo gives latitude 36.27133 and longitude -95.90837 but its address text points to a different place about 1.3 kilometers away.
location.review_note: The permit coordinates and the permit's own street address disagree. Satellite images of both places show open or cleared ground and no data center yet.
